notes: Parsed from the {{Spell-box-skill}} templates on the 'Battle spells' page. status = section of the page (Current / Removed Battle Spells).
cooldownSeconds in seconds; the wiki lists 0 for Recall and Healing (no real cooldown value given; Healing description is 'TBA' on the wiki).
unlockPlayerLevel = account level needed to unlock the spell (not hero level).
levelScaling lists are per hero level 1..15 where given (e.g. Execute / Retribution base damage).
Retribution variants (Flame/Ice/Bloody) come from the jungle boots blessing; see mechanics/retribution.md and mechanics/battle-spells.md.

spells.name: Recall
spells.description: Teleports you back to the base after 5 seconds. Moving or taking damage cancels the effect.
spells.notes:
*Default battle spell
*Unavailable in Brawl
*Has customizable effects

spells.name: Execute
spells.description:
Deals 100 (+10 × Hero Level) (+enemy's 13% Lost HP) True Damage to the designated enemy hero.
This damage ignores shield. If the target is slain by this skill, its cooldown will be reduced by 40%.
spells.notes: *A dying enemy with Immortality available still reduces the cooldown.

spells.name: Retribution
spells.description:
Deals 520 (+80 × Hero Level) True Damage to creeps and minions.
Passive: Creep rewards are increased by 60%, and damage taken from creeps is reduced by 50%. Minion rewards are reduced by 70% for the first 5 minutes.
Blessing: Reach 5 creep kills, hero kills, or hero kill assists to level up this skill (the skill decided by the Blessing of the Jungling Footwear purchased). Reaching 15 increases Physical Attack and Magic Power by 15.
Flame: Dealing 100 True Damage and absorbing 35-70 Physical Attack and Magic Power from the target over 3 seconds (scales with level).
Ice: Dealing 100 True Damage and absorbing 41-90 Movement Speed from the target over 3 seconds (scales with level).
Bloody: Deals 100 True Damage and steals HP  equal to 250 plus 20% of the caster's Extra HP from the target over 3 seconds (Deals Magic Damage).
spells.notes:
*This spell is required for purchasing Jungling Equipment Footwear items now.
**Jungle equipment footwear items will be locked and cannot be purchased if using other spells such as Petrify, Aegis, Purify, Flicker, etc.
**If Jungle equipment footwear items was purchased, can Reduces the EXP & Gold gain from minions by 70% in the first 5 minutes of the match and adds 30 Gold gained from kills or assist.
*Only when total creep kills, hero kills, or hero kill assists reach 5 can Retribution be upgraded. Minion kills are excluded.

spells.name: Inspire
spells.description:
For up to 6 Basic Attacks within the next 5 seconds, increase Attack Speed to 1.5 times and the Attack Speed cap to 500%.
The Basic Attacks also ignore 8(+1*Hero Level) of target's Hybrid Defense and restore 60 (+15% Total Physical Attack) (+10% Total Magic Power) HP on hit.
spells.calc:
The Attack Speed increase is added to the Total Attack Speed, instead of as Extra Attack Speed and can be defined as:
$\begin{align}
\mathrm{{\color{LimeGreen}ATK\ Speed}} & = [{\color{LimeGreen}Base\ ATK\ Speed} + ({\color{LimeGreen}Extra\ ATK\ Speed} \times {ATK\ Speed\ Coefficient})]\times (1 + 55%\ {\color{LimeGreen} ATK\ Speed})\\
\mathrm{if}\ {\color{LimeGreen}ATK\ Speed} & \geq 3.00
\end{align}$
spells.notes:
*At max hero level (15), it will ignore a total of 23 Hybrid Defense.
*Inspire's enhanced basic attacks can be consumed via basic attacks, or any skill that is counted as basic attack e.g. Silvanna's Skill 2: Spiral Strangling.
*The enhanced basic attacks are not an Attack Effect, as they are not triggered by Golden Staff's passive. However, Badang's Skill 1: Fist Wind seems to be an exception.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.description: Gains up to 50% extra Movement Speed and slow immunity for 6s. The extra Movement Speed gradually decays after 2s.
spells.notes:
*Suppression & Restrained cannot reducing durations.
*Rooted cannot be removed after summoned Royal Guards by Minsitthar's King's Calling.

spells.name: Revitalize
spells.description:
Summons a Healing Spring that restores 2.5% Max HP every 0.5 second for 5 seconds (maximum of 25% Max HP).
Increases the Shield and HP Regen by 25% for allies within the area of effect (this effect is cannot be stacked up).
spells.notes:
*Can be used when being controlled.
*Multiple casts fully stack.

spells.name: Aegis
spells.description:
Immediately gains a shield that absorbs 750 (+50 × Hero Level) shield damage for 5 seconds.
The nearby ally with the lowest HP also gains 525 (+35 × Hero Level) (+70% Lost HP) shield.

spells.name: Petrify
spells.description: Deals 100 (+15 × Hero Level) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and petrifies them for 0.8s. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 50% for 0.8s afterward.

spells.name: Purify
spells.description:
Immediately removes all negative effects.
In the next 1.2 seconds, gains control immunity and 15% Movement Speed.
spells.notes:
*Suppression can neither be removed nor blocked during the duration.
*Purify cannot remove or grant immunity to Rooted applied by Royal Guards from Minsitthar's King's Calling.

spells.name: Flameshot
spells.description:
Fires a Flaming Shot in a designated direction, dealing 160 (+60% Total Magic Power)–640 +180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (scales on distance) and slowing the target by 30% for 0.5 second.
Casting the skill knocks back nearby enemies.

spells.name: Flicker
spells.description: Moves a certain distance in a designated direction. Then gains 6 (+1 × Hero Level) Physical and Magic Defense for 1 second.
spells.notes:
*Has the distance of 3.8.
*Treated as blink ability in abilities' description.
**Therefore it is unaffected by Khufra's bouncing ball.
*Does not interrupt the cast animation of most abilities.
*This spell can be disabled by Rooted effect and immobilized.

spells.name: Arrival
spells.description: Teleports to an allied turret (including destroyed turrets), base, or minion after channeling for 3 seconds, gaining 60% movement speed that will decay in 3 seconds. If the channeling is cancelled or interrupted, the cooldown will be reduced by 30 seconds.
spells.notes:
*If channeling is cancelled or interrupted, the cooldown will be reduced by 30 seconds.
*The selected allied turret or minion will be temporarily becoming untargetable and immune to all damage while chanting. The selected minion is also immobilized for the duration.
*This spell can be interrupted by Crowd Control effects during chanting.
*Casting this ability on a turret before the first minion will reveal the user for the enemy until the movement speed bonus expires.

spells.name: Vengeance
spells.description:
In the next 3 seconds, each time the hero takes damage deals 40% of the damage taken as Magic Damage to the enemy.
Gains 35% Damage Reduction during the period.

spells.name: Healing Spell
spells.description:
Restores 14% of Hero Max HP and 10% of Hero Max Mana, and surrounding allied heroes for up to 12% of their Max HP (depending on the number of nearby allied heroes) and 10% of their Max Mana.
Restores additional 165 (+15 × Hero Level) HP HP to most injured allied Heroes (including themselves).

spells.name: Interference
spells.description: Silences defensive turrets for 5 seconds and lowers their defense by 10.

spells.name: Weaken
spells.description: Reduces the target hero's movement speed by 70% and Physical Attack and Magic Power by 50% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Track
spells.description: Summons Harper to search for nearest enemy hero. Reduces revealed Hero Movement Speed by 70%, Physical and Magical Attack by 50% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Iron Wall
spells.description: In 3 seconds, Physical and Magic Damage taken is reduced by 40%.
